children: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (KRX:000660) faces near-term selling on memory oversupply and margin risks even as DRAM prices and longer‑term demand could improve, plans new Gwangju fabs and HBM cooling work, eyes a Solidigm IPO, and confronts activist safety probes.
Previous Week Recap
SK hynix ADR Intraday Decline
: SK hynix ADR (000660) fell intraday, trading near $165–$169 after ~7.2% decline since Oct. 7; foreign investors net sold amid semiconductor memory weakness and oversupply concerns.
DRAM Prices Up YoY Outlook
: SK hynix (000660): DRAM prices seen up ~10–15% YoY for Q4. Traders note margin risk as SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron plan capacity ramp 2025–2028, possibly tempering profit growth.
Two New Fabs Planned
: SK hynix (000660) plans two new chip fabs in Gwangju, about two-thirds the Yongin size. Start dates pending; company may speed piling or run parallel builds. Timeline and infra talks ongoing.
Solidigm IPO Plans In 2027
: Solidigm, SK hynix subsidiary (000660), hired Goldman, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Citi and UBS for a planned U.S. IPO around 2027; seeks about $10B pre-IPO funding and up to $100B valuation
Mirae Keeps Buy; Target 3.1M
: Mirae Asset keeps Buy on SK hynix (000660) with 3.1M won target, citing tighter 2028 memory demand and potential HBM price upside; notes near-term volatility.
Cooling Solutions For HBM4E
: SK hynix Inc. ADR (000660) works on cooling solutions for HBM4E memory as interposers are expected to grow to fit more compute and memory chips in 2.5D AI packaging.
Macro Improvement Needed For Break
: Analyst Na Jung-hwan says SK hynix (000660) benefits from structural semiconductor growth but needs a macro improvement to break its trading range; record exports haven't drawn foreign buyers.
SHARPS Cancers Classification Request
: Activist group SHARPS asked South Korea to classify cancers in three former SK hynix (000660) workers as occupational, citing workplace use of carcinogens including nickel compounds.
Health, Safety Measures Expanded
: SK hynix (000660) says it has stepped up health and work-safety measures, set a global support and compensation plan, and will fully cooperate with government probes; no comment on specific cases.
Call To Confirm Work-Linked Cancer
: A relative of former employee Kim Yong-il urged SK hynix (000660) and authorities to confirm his wife’s 2018 cancer was work-related after exposure at SK hynix’s Icheon plant (1996–2018).
This is an AI-generated summary and may contain inaccuracies. Please verify any important information with the original sources.
